acceptance_criteria.criterion: Each of the 4 handlers has a describe block in api.test.ts specifically for the namespaced path scenario.
Each block asserts that the handler reads from {repoName}/{slug}/orchestrator/{dialogues|chunks}/ — not the flat {slug}/ path.
Each block asserts that providing repoName causes the handler to use the correct namespaced directory.
Each block asserts that a non-existent project returns an HTTP 404 response (via resolveProjectStore NOT_FOUND).
All pre-existing tests in api.test.ts continue to pass (zero regressions).

summary: Added 4 new describe blocks to mcp-server/tests/gui/api.test.ts — one per handler (handleListDialogues, handleGetDialogueFile, handleListChunks, handleGetChunkFile) — each with 3 tests: (1) verifies the handler reads from {repoName}/{slug}/orchestrator/{dialogues|chunks}/ when repoName is provided, (2) asserts that store.storageDir resolves to join(ledgerRoot, 'my-repo', slug) confirming repoName is honoured, (3) asserts ApiError NOT_FOUND for a non-existent project under the given repoName. All 12 new tests pass; full suite (2342 tests, 79 files) passes with zero regressions.
